blogPosts.title: Maintaining Your Deck in Melbourne's Climate: Notting Hill Tips
blogPosts.excerpt: Get practical advice on deck maintenance in Notting Hill to protect against Melbourne's weather and extend its lifespan.
body: Deck maintenance in Notting Hill requires attention to Melbourne's variable climate, which includes hot summers, cool winters, and occasional heavy rain. Regular care prevents issues like warping, rot, and fading. Start with sweeping to remove debris, then wash the deck with mild detergent and water at least twice a year. This simple routine keeps the surface clean and reduces mold growth.

Seasonal checks are crucial for long-term deck health. In spring, inspect for loose nails, splintering wood, or water damage. Summer demands UV protection with sealants or stains to prevent cracking from heat. Autumn involves clearing leaves to avoid moisture buildup, and winter may require checking for frost damage. Professional services in Notting Hill, like Property Maintenance Melbourne, can handle these tasks efficiently.

Choosing the right products matters for Australian conditions. Use sealants or oils that offer UV and water resistance, suitable for Melbourne's intense sunlight and rain. Timber decks benefit from oiling every 6-12 months, while composite materials need less frequent treatment.
